record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The two units in appliesTo declare NIGHT_DAZE: Zorua (1 star) and Zoroark (2 stars), both with the ILLUSION passive. The strategy is shared; only the damage depends on the casting unit's stars. Units not listed are not covered; the Hisuian forms use BITTER_MALICE, a separate identifier.
record.summary: Special damage plus Blinded. Normal case: only the cast target takes special damage (raw 25 / 50 / 100 / 200 by caster stars: 25 Zorua, 50 Zoroark; x(1 + AP/100), crit factor only with ABILITY_CRIT, reduced by speDef with a minimum of 1) and Blinded for a raw 3000 ms (x(1 + caster AP/100), halved for an enraged victim, then the victim's duration reductions). Disguised case: if the caster's entity index differs from the index of its own name (ILLUSION copies the left neighbour's index), the damage and the blind hit EVERY enemy on the 3x3 block centred on the cast target (centre included) instead of the target alone. In both cases the index is reset to the unit's own on every cast, breaking the disguise. A blinded unit's basic attacks give their target +0.5 dodge chance. The blind is applied even if the damage was blocked.

targeting.who: not disguised: the caster's current target; disguised: every enemy of the caster in the 3x3 block centred on the target (centre included)
targeting.note: requiresTarget is the default true. The disguised test is evaluated before the index is reset, so the disguise counts for this cast. The target list is built before the loop, from cell values captured by getAdjacentCells.

geometry.shape: single target, or (when disguised) the 3x3 block around the target, centre included, enemies only; off-board cells skipped

declaredRaw.label: raw special damage by caster stars (requested amount)

effects.scaling: requested = 25 (Zorua, 1 star) / 50 (Zoroark, 2 stars). Applied: x(1 + caster AP / 100) (apBoost default true), x2 if the caster is enraged, crit factor 1 + (critPower - 1) x reduction only if crit (needs ABILITY_CRIT)
effects.resolution: no damage if the victim has protect, skydiving or magicBounce (magicBounce can reflect part to the caster). Then PokemonState.handleDamage: special damage / (1 + ARMOR_FACTOR x speDef), armorReduction halves speDef, minimum 1 after Math.ceil, shield absorbs first. Three amounts: requested = table; applied = after AP / crit / defense / floor of 1; takenDamage (returned, unused here) = shield + hp actually lost. Each target in the disguised case gets the full damage (no split).

declaredRaw.label: fixed raw duration before AP, enrage and reductions

statusEffects.scaling: requested = 3000 ms; AP-scaled (apBoost true, origin = caster): 3000 x (1 + AP/100); no star scaling, no crit scaling
statusEffects.resolution: Requested vs applied. Applied only if the victim is not already blinded and has no rune protect (a blinded victim is NOT refreshed). Then /2 if the victim is enraged, then SWIFT_SWIM x0.7 / HYDRATION x0.5 / WATER_VEIL or SURGE_SURFER x0.3 and Odd Keystone -10% each, rounded. Effect found: while blinded, the victim's basic attacks give their target +0.5 dodge chance; the dodge roll is skipped by XRAY_VISION, LOCK_ON and against a paralysed, sleeping, frozen or locked target. Ends when blindCooldown runs out. Effects on abilities or movement were not found.

starBehavior.note: Only the damage table is indexed by the casting entity's stars (fallback 200); the blind duration is fixed. Whether other mechanics change an entity's star count was not examined.

record.positionalConditions: Disguised cast: the enemies hit are those in the 3x3 block around the cast target (positions captured before any damage). Not disguised: the target alone.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: Two modes decided at cast time by the disguise test. The index is reset on every cast, so the disguised mode can only happen again after ILLUSION copies a neighbour's index (it fires on a position change during the player's board arrangement). No other stored state. Each cast spends maxPP of PP.
record.rawVsResolved: Requested: special damage 25 / 50 raw and Blinded 3000 ms raw (AP-scaled) on 1 target, or on every enemy in the 3x3 block when disguised. Applied: damage after AP, enrage, crit, speDef and the floor of 1 (zero if protected); blind after the already-blinded / rune-protect guards, enrage halving and duration reductions.
